lateral_flank_blob_constellation.centroid_triangulation: A series of high-luminance circular clusters are arranged in approximately four vertical columns posterior to the gill region. The most prominent column contains five distinct large blobs centered vertically on the mid-flank.
lateral_flank_blob_constellation.stripe_intersections: Faint vertical bands of elevated pixel intensity are visible, intersecting the horizontal rows of blobs to form a grid-like structure of anchor nodes across the visible lateral surface.

carinae_gradient_vectors.ridge_trajectory: A sharp horizontal feature is visible along the dorsal-lateral interface, characterized by a high-intensity luminance gradient on the superior edge and a distinct shadow on the inferior edge.

other_distinctive_markers: The primary visible pectoral fin exhibits a high-density distribution of micro-spots that are significantly smaller and more closely packed than the macro-spots found on the lateral flank.
